caption: The reflection of a moored boat lies on clear still water, and when the boat rocks the reflection breaks apart and then settles.

sa.check: A moored boat's reflection lies on clear still water.
The rocking comes first, then the break-up, then the settling.

pc.expect: The reflection wavers and fragments as the boat rocks and returns when the water calms.
pc.fail: It stays sharp while the boat rocks; or breaks up with the boat still; or never returns on calm water.

pc.expect: The clear reflection is the boat inverted, attached at the waterline.
pc.fail: It is upright; or detached; or a different boat.

pc.expect: The water is liquid: ripples spread from the hull and fade.
pc.fail: It is rigid; or the ripples freeze; or the water leaps.

pc.expect: The reflection does not move with the boat and water still.
pc.fail: It drifts; or shifts on a flat calm.

pc.expect: One boat and one reflection; the reflection stays on the water.
pc.fail: A second boat appears; or the reflection rises off the water; or the boat vanishes; or the reflection becomes solid.

pc.expect: The boat and the mooring stay the same.
pc.fail: The boat changes colour; or the mooring changes; or the shore rearranges.
